question: Which of the following is true for Aggregate Demand (AD)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AD = C + I + G**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aggregate Demand (AD)** is the total demand for goods and services in an economy at a given overall price level and in a given time period.
 
• It is represented by the formula **AD = C + I + G**, where:
 
 
• **C** stands for consumption expenditure.
 
• **I** stands for investment expenditure.
 
• **G** stands for government expenditure.
 
 
 
• This formula indicates that AD is the sum of consumption, investment, and government spending.
 
• Other options given in the question do not correctly represent the components of Aggregate Demand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aggregate Demand** plays a crucial role in the analysis of economic fluctuations and policy-making.
 
• Changes in AD can lead to economic growth or recession, depending on whether the demand is increasing or decreasing.
 
• Factors influencing AD include changes in consumer confidence, interest rates, government policies, and global economic conditions.
